title: Camavinga Talks About the Disappointment of Missing the World Cup
seoTitle: Camavinga: Disappointment of Missing World Cup
subtitle: Real Madrid midfielder reveals what he needs to improve to gain the trust of Mourinho and Zidane
excerpt: Eduardo Camavinga, 23, says missing France's World Cup squad was a huge disappointment and he seeks more consistency to become a Real Madrid starter.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Eduardo Camavinga, 23, arrived at Real Madrid five years ago as one of French football's biggest promises. Recently, he spoke openly about the frustration of being left out of Didier Deschamps' World Cup squad and what he still needs to improve to secure a permanent spot in José Mourinho's team.

Disappointment at Missing the World Cup

Camavinga explained that missing the opportunity to participate in the World Cup was “something new” for him, but stressed that the main lesson was to get back up again. The midfielder stated that the disappointment impacted him emotionally, but that his reaction was fundamental for his development.

Seeking More Consistency

When asked what he lacks to become a regular starter at Real Madrid, Camavinga acknowledged that he still needs more consistency. “I have good performances, but I need to be more consistent,” he declared. He also emphasized the need for greater concentration on the field and to make fewer mistakes.

Trust from Mourinho and Zidane

The player highlighted the importance of trust from coach José Mourinho and former player Zinedine Zidane, who currently holds a position at the club. Camavinga stated that he wants to “receive trust” and that it is “very special to be under Zidane's orders,” acknowledging the weight the name carries in the country.

Next Challenge in the Nations League

Camavinga also spoke about the match against Belgium on the second matchday of the Nations League group stage, which will be his next test. He emphasized that the competition represents an opportunity to show progress and regain his place in the French national team.

Future Prospects

Although he acknowledges that he still has much to improve, Camavinga remained optimistic, stating that “I still have a lot of time ahead of me.” The midfielder believes that, with hard work and focus, he can consolidate his position both at Real Madrid and in the French national team.

With information from Mundo Deportivo.
